The Verses of the Elder Somamitta:
"Just as one who has climbed onto a small piece of wood might sink in the great ocean;"
Thus, by relying on one who is indolent,
even a person of virtuous life comes to fail;
therefore, one should avoid such a person.
One who is indolent and of inferior energy.
Together with the noble ones who dwell in seclusion,
who are resolute, and who are meditators;
"One should always dwell together with wise ones who have aroused their energy. ...
